title: Commission Plans
noPlansDescription: Build your first commission plan to assign to sales representatives. Support for flat rates, tiers, and accelerators.
clawbackTooltip: If a deal is reversed or cancelled within this period, the commission will be deducted from the rep.
deletePlanDescription: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone. Reps assigned to this plan will need a new plan.
planDeletedDescription: The commission plan has been removed.
syncFailedDelete: Failed to delete plan. Reverted changes.
planDescription: Configure how commissions are calculated for deals.
upgradeForClawback: Upgrade to Growth to enable automatic commission clawbacks.
flatTypeTooltip: A single fixed rate applied to every deal amount.
tieredTypeTooltip: Different marginal rates apply to portions of the deal as it passes each tier boundary (like tax brackets).
acceleratorTypeTooltip: A higher rate is applied to the full deal amount when it exceeds the accelerator threshold.
noPermissionPlans: You don't have permission to view commission plans.
